fichas.title: Hospital plant and service rooms
fichas.summary: Planning guidance for hospital building-services areas, including air-conditioning, cooling and recooling plant. Emphasizes efficient routing, hygiene, energy use, maintenance access, safety, and control of noise and vibration.
uses: Provide air-conditioning, cooling and recooling services
furniture_equipment: Cold-water and cooled-water distributors and collectors

dimensions.label: Minimum clear height of central plant room
dimensions.context: Minimum clear height for optimal operation.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The minimum height of a central plant room should be 3 m clear

dimensions.label: Central plant room height
dimensions.context: Height given in relation to the number of functional units.
dimensions.ocr_raw: 4-4.5 m following the number of functional units

dimensions.label: Air-conditioning equipment estimation air speed
dimensions.context: Speed used to estimate the size of air-conditioning equipment from volume flow.
dimensions.ocr_raw: the size of the air-conditioning equipment can be estimated via the volume flow with a speed of 2 m/s

dimensions.label: Cooling plant room height
dimensions.context: Room heights should be more than this figure; may depend on output.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Room heights should be more than 3 m, which may depend on the output.

fichas.title: Technical conditions and equipment for plant rooms
fichas.summary: Specifies environmental and utility provisions for hospital plant rooms, including temperature limits, water and drainage, electrical connections, lighting levels, and fire and workplace safety considerations.
spaces: Switching panels and control equipment area
uses: Protect equipment from frost, overheating and damp
Provide water, drainage, electrical power and lighting
Meet fire-protection and workplace safety requirements

dimensions.label: Minimum plant-room temperature
dimensions.context: Temperature must not fall below this for technical reasons and to avoid frost danger.
dimensions.ocr_raw: must not sink below soc for technical reasons (danger of frost!)

dimensions.label: Maximum plant-room temperature
dimensions.context: Temperature should not exceed this because of electrical equipment.
dimensions.ocr_raw: should also not exceed 40 oc (because of electrical equipment)

dimensions.label: Power socket voltage
dimensions.context: Minimum provision of at least one power socket in plant rooms.

dimensions.ocr_raw: at least one power socket (230 V, 16 A)

dimensions.label: Three-phase connection voltage
dimensions.context: Connection suitable for the particular situation.

dimensions.context: Nominal lighting intensity in plant rooms.

dimensions.label: Lighting intensity at panels and measurement equipment

fichas.title: Service shafts, suspended ceilings and gas supply
fichas.summary: Guidance on routing vertical and horizontal services, fire resistance and access for shafts, suspended-ceiling service zones, and the location and supply of medical gas equipment and cylinders.
uses: Route vertical and horizontal building services
Limit fire and smoke spread through shafts and ducts
